text:
```yaml
name: Deploy Server

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        cargo build --release
        npm install

    - name: Run Jest tests
      run: |
        npx jest --silent --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit > jest-results.xml

    - name: Filter Jest results
      run: |
        cat jest-results.xml | grep -E 'FAIL|●' > filtered-jest-results.xml

    - name: Upload test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: jest-results
        path: filtered-jest-results.xml

    - name: Run integration tests
      run: |
        cargo test --release
        npm run test
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a pipeline to build and test a Rust project using the latest stable version of Rust. It installs dependencies, runs Jest tests with the `--silent` flag to reduce noise, filters the Jest results to keep only `FAIL` lines and error details, uploads the filtered results as an artifact, and runs integration tests using both Cargo and npm.
